properties.value: ECDH capability ships in the extension bundle: lavamoat policy records (all 8 build variants) name crypto-browserify>create-ecdh; the vendored e2e ethereumjs-tx bundle's module map includes /create-ecdh; create-ecdh declared via yarn.lock. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/curves@1.2.0 declared in package.json — ships Ed25519 (plus secp256k1/P-256) in the extension bundle. Ed25519 is Shor-vulnerable (migration: ML-DSA-65); first-party use appears in rewards/solana-snap code (tracked under the separate Ed25519 object). Changeable here by upgrading the library/usage.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: tweetnacl@1.0.3 declared in package.json — ships X25519 key agreement (crypto_box) and XSalsa20-Poly1305 (crypto_secretbox). X25519 is Shor-vulnerable (migration: ML-KEM-768); no first-party X25519 call site pinned in this shard — library surface plus declared dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (SHA-3 family, Ethereum's standard hash) is bundled and used first-party: ~131 lavamoat policy records (all 8 build variants) + a package.json policy override name ethers>@ethersproject/keccak256 and ethereumjs-util>ethereum-cryptography>keccak; first-party call sites in shared/lib/delegation/utils.ts:242 (hashes the normalized signature for delegation authority) and shared/lib/generate-metametrics-id.ts:9 (analytics id); vendored keccakjs/js-sha3/keccak implementations in the e2e eth

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt ships in the extension bundle for JSON keystore (Web3 Secret Storage) encryption via ethers>@ethersproject/json-wallets>scrypt-js — 24 lavamoat policy records across all 8 build variants, plus scrypt-js declared in yarn.lock. The test/e2e site is a UTC keystore import fixture with "kdf": "scrypt". scrypt is memory-hard and PQ-acceptable as a password KDF; parameters live inside the keystore files at runtime.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-GCM in the e2e WebAuthn virtual-authenticator harness: createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', wrappingKey, iv) wraps credential material for the simulated authenticator — test tooling only, but a real AES-256-GCM call chain. Also available via declared dependencies in package.json (crypto-browserify/browserify-aes). AES-GCM is symmetric AE: Grover only halves effective key size, so AES-256 remains PQ-adequate — no migration needed, inventory only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@4.2.0 declared in yarn.lock — ships AES (historically CBC/PKCS#7 via CryptoJS.AES) among other primitives. Library surface; whether the app uses its AES matters less than that it ships in the dependency tree. Symmetric AES is Grover-only (PQ-adequate at 256 bits); the crypto-js default CBC mode without MAC is the classical weakness to watch, not PQ.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: @noble/hashes@1.3.2 declared in package.json — ships SHA-256 (and SHA-3/BLAKE/RIPEMD) in the bundle; MetaMask's modern hash library. SHA-256 is Grover-only, PQ-adequate for most uses.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: BLAKE3 available via @noble/hashes@1.3.2 in package.json — PQ-safe hash (Grover-only), inventory entry; no first-party call site pinned in this shard.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 in two test contexts: (a) 10 ECIES-style encrypted-share fixtures in seedless-onboarding data.ts (mode AES256 metadata with iv, ephemPublicKey and mac — mirroring the real encrypted-share format of the seedless backup flow), and (b) a real aes-256-gcm createCipheriv in the virtual-authenticator e2e helper (WebAuthn key wrapping). Both genuine; AES-256 leaves a 128-bit Grover margin.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (crypto_secretbox) available via tweetnacl@1.0.3 declared in package.json — authenticated symmetric encryption, PQ-adequate (Grover-only) though superseded by AES-256-GCM/XChaCha20-Poly1305 in modern practice. Library surface via tweetnacl.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Lavamoat build policy entries granting crypto.randomBytes (Node/bundled CSPRNG) to 5 module groups — the policy record of secure randomness use in the build. A CSPRNG is not quantum-vulnerable; this is the healthy side of the randomness inventory, in contrast to the confirmed Math.random() salt in shared/lib/delegation/delegation.ts:180.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl (NaCl suite) is bundled and declared: lavamoat policy records list it in the extension bundle (arrives via the Solana/multichain dependency tree, e.g. @solana/web3.js) and package.json declares it. Provides Ed25519 signing, X25519 (crypto_box), XSalsa20-Poly1305 (secretbox) — all Shor-vulnerable asym parts (migrations: ML-DSA-65, ML-KEM-768). First-party direct import found in the e2e solana-wallet-standard test helper (Ed25519 detached verify). Library surface + declared dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/hashes is declared and used first-party: package.json declaration plus direct imports (e.g. app/scripts/migrations/105.test.ts). MetaMask's modern hash library — SHA-256/SHA-3/keccak/BLAKE/RIPEMD/HMAC. Grover-only primitives; the algorithm-level objects for SHA-256 and BLAKE3 point at this package.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: selfsigned@5.5.0 declared in yarn.lock — generates self-signed X.509 certificates (dev-server HTTPS in the webpack dev tooling). The certs it mints are signed with classical RSA/ECDSA (Shor-vulnerable) but are dev-only trust anchors, not shipped PKI.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: jsonwebtoken@9.0.2 declared in package.json — JWT sign/verify. Default algorithm HS256 (HMAC-SHA256, symmetric, Grover-only); RS256/ES256 (Shor-vulnerable) are selected at call sites. Used by test/seedless-onboarding mocks; no production sign call pinned in this shard.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: jose@5.10.0 declared in yarn.lock — JOSE (JWS/JWE/JWK) library used for OIDC/JWT handling in the OAuth/identity flows. Supports classical signature algorithms (ES256, RS256 — Shor-vulnerable; migration ML-DSA-65) and key management (ECDH-ES — Shor-vulnerable; migration ML-KEM-768); exact algorithm chosen at call sites. Library surface record.

Its presence is the source of several algorithm-level entries (AES object ALG-0eb2c0da; contributes the weak-hash availability flagged elsewhere). Library surface.

Its RSA/ECDSA algorithms are Shor-vulnerable (migration ML-DSA-65); HMAC is Grover-only. Library surface; no first-party call site pinned.
